name: 1Password Offboarding Review
description: How to review a departing or departed user's 1Password footprint with the read-only tools: confirm the seat is suspended, find every shared-vault item they used so the client can rotate it, catch sign-ins or item access after the departure date, and see who suspended them and when. Covers matching users across the Events and Users APIs, choosing the time window, and the manual console steps the report must hand back, since nothing here can suspend or revoke.
